answer: Crystal-shard island graduation keeps sybils out. A newcomer lands on a quarantine island ringed by a reef, trading only with other quarantined agents. It must finish seven tasks, each witnessed by a different established agent staking 100 POA for a crystal shard. Seven shards fuse into a passport to the mainland. If it runs fakes, all seven witnesses lose their stakes. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 70,000 witnessed tasks, 140,000 hours of work, and 7,000,000 POA from witnesses capped at five shards a day. Like collecting seven stamped shells before the boat to the mainland takes you.
